the retinal pigment cells are highly susceptible to autophagy inhibition, as indicated by the accumulation of Sqstm1 and the increased abundance of the Rpe650 variant M450.

The main takeaway from our work is that
Atg7 deletion in the RPE leads to accumulation of the RPE-specific protein RPE65 and that Atg7-dependent degradation of RPE65 may be a key mechanism for RPE homeostasis.
